label: fixture
title: Same npm workspace identity conflict when the naive export change is unused
notes: apps/web-unused imports only format. format exists in both trees. localOnly is removed on the registry stand-in but unused. Unused export change is not a caller defect — and also must not settle the packet to no_action while identity is unresolved.

naiveExportDiffIfIdentitiesWereSame.note: If identity were the same, unused localOnly removal + unused parse add would be no_action. Identity conflict overrides that to unknown.

decisionNotes: Unused export change is not a caller defect (packet rule 2).
That rule does not yield no_action here: unused-change attribution requires a single package identity.
Lockfile still points at workspace packages/shared-kit; upgrade target is a registry locator of the same name ⇒ unknown (rules 3 and 5).
A newer version is not itself a break (packet rule 1).
